name: Phantom Squares
description: Discs with a quarter bitten out, the bites of each four facing one another so pale squares that are never drawn appear between them.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((33 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((33 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%), conic-gradient(from @calc(round(((@x % 2) * (@y % 2) * 90 + (1 - (@x % 2)) * (@y % 2) * 180 + (1 - (@x % 2)) * (1 - (@y % 2)) * 270) * 100) / 100)deg at 50% 50%, transparent 0 90deg, #000 90deg 360deg); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(round((33 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% @calc(round((33 + 9 * (1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))))) * 100) / 100)% at 50% 50%, #000 0 100%, transparent 100%), conic-gradient(from @calc(round(((@x % 2) * (@y % 2) * 90 + (1 - (@x % 2)) * (@y % 2) * 180 + (1 - (@x % 2)) * (1 - (@y % 2)) * 270) * 100) / 100)deg at 50% 50%, transparent 0 90deg, #000 90deg 360deg); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
